programRef: Cross-cutting UAT-instrument workstream for the world-engine program (ROADMAP-v2 increments all terminate at Max's lab UAT); north star recorded 2026-07-14: a fresh person judges a world in 30s.
designDecisions: RUNS ON L1 IN THE MAIN CHECKOUT, MAIN-SESSION-DRIVEN: lane A owns the lab HTML; per Max's standing 2026-07-11 directive, workflows build features while the MAIN session owns lab UI/UX. This work is iterative with Max in-thread, not workflow-built. The concurrent atmo derive-not-freeze branch keeps its lab-HTML footprint minimal and rebases onto L1 before merge-back.

QUARANTINE + BADGE (Max's ruling): legacy randomly-applied controls move into a collapsed 'Legacy' section; writer-driven controls get a visible provenance mark; deletion only for provably-dead controls (reversible-first). No feature code is deleted in this workstream — GUI reorganization only.

DEFAULTS ARE PER-WORLD-TYPE: a fresh lab load enables the features that matter for judging that preset (water on water worlds; bands/storms/polar on giants). The default set per preset is agreed with Max in-session as the IA lands.

INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE AGREED IN-SESSION: the nav pane shrinks to a small set of logically-ordered top-level groups. Max is the evaluator of the IA at each step (step-at-a-time, his exact words drive grouping); the contract pins the outcome bar, not the folder tree.

TRUSTING-STATE EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE (Max did not pick it as a friction): stale-override/same-preset-reselect gotchas stay as documented lab gotchas unless they block the solo-UAT gate, in which case re-scope.
NO NEW MACHINERY: Max ruled 'decluttered lab is enough' — no one-click UAT panel, no guided mode. Existing preset picker + reroll buttons remain the drive surface.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Spine conformance (Rule 15, SPINE-CONFORMANCE.md), scoped to a GUI-only workstream: (1) Driver connectivity — asserted N/A: this workstream reads no new scalars and adds no derivations (a new driver-reading control would be out of scope). (2) Named consumer — asserted N/A: no fields emitted. (3) Taxonomy registration — LIVE: the reorganized GUI keeps every retained feature control registered and scrape-visible — the planet-archetypes.test.js orphan-folder guard (which scrapes the literal .add(state,'<x>Enabled') form) and sibling drift guards stay green after every move; controls that deliberately live off the guard (the rings-proxy pattern) keep their documented proxy form.

verifyVia.input: Run the planet-archetypes drift-guard suite from the repo dir after each reorganization commit; diff audit confirms GUI layout/label changes only.
verifyVia.observable: Drift guards green; no new state reads/derivations in the diff.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A fresh lab load is judgment-ready per world type under the RATIFIED composition rule: writer-driven features ON (per provenance x rendersOn), plus a small per-world-class DRESSING set of driver-fed legacy so worlds read as worlds (wet terrestrials boot with ocean/coastlines/clouds/limb/terminator; identity features like Magma's ocean boot on); features with NO driver connection (technogenic exotics etc.) NEVER default on. Features enable only when they should.

verifyVia.input: Fresh page load (new context, no persisted state) for each preset in the DEFAULTS table (data-defined next to ASSOCIATIONS).
verifyVia.observable: _lab.state enabled set == writerSet(preset) UNION dressing(preset) exactly; un-driven legacy (bioMats/machine/cityLights/ecumenopolis/hexTess/shatter) reads false on EVERY preset; a composition screenshot at judging distance is archived per preset CLASS (not just per mechanism) before presenting; no console errors.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Max's condition on the ratified defaults: the UI makes it very clear what's a current system and what is a placeholder legacy system slated for replacement -- for the BOOTED composition, not just the folder tree: default-enabled legacy dressing is visibly marked as placeholder without opening the quarantine drawer; the legacy drawer title says it is placeholder/slated-for-replacement; the World Engine section never reads 'Empty' on a world whose relief the writer carrier is authoring.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Legacy randomly-applied controls live under a collapsed 'Legacy' section and writer-driven controls carry a visible provenance mark — what's the new procgen model vs old legacy features is legible at a glance.
